svg.text: All listed actions use your existing bindings. Context determines what the game does.
Rear: L4 / L5 on the left · R4 / R5 on the right
Base = no modifier · L4 / L5 = hold that rear button · Hold ≠ a separate Steam Long Press

g.text: Base · Y axis · Move → Space / Left Ctrl
Base · X axis · Move → Q / E
L4 · X axis · Move → A / D
Systems / interaction: MFD left / right (during interaction)
L4 · down · Press → Left Alt + N
Systems / interaction: Open inventory during interaction (Tap)
Systems / interaction: Open loot screen during interaction (Hold)
Base · click · Click → Right Alt + K
Systems / interaction: Toggle ship ports / doors
L4 · Double press → Right Alt + L
Mining: Fire mining laser (Tap or hold)
Salvage: Fire focused salvage tool (Tap or hold)
Systems / interaction: Zoom in in interaction mode
Systems / interaction: Zoom out in interaction mode
L5 · ↑ · Scroll → Left Alt + Mouse Wheel Up
L5 · ↓ · Scroll → Left Alt + Mouse Wheel Down
L5 · click · Click → Left Alt + C
Steam first recognizes the Long Press, then sends B. Keep holding for the
Scanning: Ping (Double press; hold second press for charged ping)
The PDF requires holding and releasing Tab; verify charged ping in game.
L4 · Press → Left Alt + Left Mouse
Base · Press → Hold Action Set Layer
Base · Press → Hold Action Set Layer
